steps.en: Install the app and enable history before reproducing a slowdown
steps.zh: 安装应用，在复现卡顿前开启历史记录

steps.en: Records system and process samples in a local history store
steps.zh: 把系统与进程采样写入本地历史库

steps.en: Open Explorer and select the time and processes to compare
steps.zh: 打开探索器，选择时间和待比较进程

steps.en: Aligns recorded signals, including observed processes that have exited
steps.zh: 对齐历史信号，也展示已退出的被记录进程

value.en: Revisit a slowdown after it ended instead of relying only on live readings
value.zh: 卡顿结束后仍能回看，不只依赖实时读数
